summary: Sacerdotii nostri primordia is the second encyclical of Pope John XXIII, issued on 1 August 1959. The Latin title translates as "From the beginning of our priesthood." The encyclical marked the 100th anniversary of the death of St. John Vianney, patron saint of priests.
one_line: Pope John XXIII's 1959 encyclical commemorating the centenary of St. John Vianney's death, patron saint of priests.
